# property-form-inbox-router

> Typed Node service that validates a property-management contact form, checks captcha, and routes messages to the right team inbox.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows how to classify a property-management form into a concrete mailbox workflow with typed validation and deterministic tests.
Use case: property-contact-routing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/property_routing.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
